entries.zh: 前超光速文明立场
entries.en: Pre-FTL Stance

entries.zh: §R废除$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§!
entries.en: §RRepeal $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§!

entries.zh: 对那些几乎没有能力离开自己家园的“文明”平等相待简直荒谬至极。[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的帝国应当有权利按各自认为合适的方式对待他们境内的低等文明。
entries.en: Treating "civilizations" that are barely even capable of leaving their homeworlds as equals is a preposterous idea. The empires of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should be allowed to treat lesser civilizations within their borders as they see fit.

entries.zh: 废除§Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§!议案。
entries.en: Repeals the §Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§! resolution.

entries.zh: §R废除$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$§!
entries.en: §RRepeal $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$§!

entries.zh: 仅仅因为有一些蛮子蹲在上头，就禁止[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的帝国充分利用合法属于他们的资源就是在亵渎我们智慧、侵害发展的权利。
entries.en: Forbidding the empires of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] from making use of resources that rightfully belongs to them just because savages squat on them is a violation of our intellectual and property rights.

entries.zh: 废除§Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$§!议案。
entries.en: Repeals the §Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$§! resolution.

entries.zh: §R废除$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_exploitation$§!
entries.en: §RRepeal $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_exploitation$§!

entries.zh: 只因其科技水平就可以将某个文明视作一种有待开发的资源简直罪不可赦。[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的帝国应当保障那些将会追随我们步入星空的文明享有和其他物种一样的权利。
entries.en: To treat another civilization solely as a source of resources to be exploited purely on the basis of their current technology is abhorrent. The empires of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should ensure that the civilizations that will follow us to the stars are guaranteed the same rights as any other species.

entries.zh: 废除§Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_exploitation$§!议案。
entries.en: Repeals the §Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_exploitation$§! resolution.

entries.zh: 平等相待法案
entries.en: Equal Standing Act

entries.zh: 每个前超光速文明都有可能获得航天技术，并加入[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]。因此，我们必须尊重每一位潜在的成员。
entries.en: Each pre-FTL civilization has the potential to acquire space flight and join the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. As such, we must treat any future members with dignity and respect.

entries.zh: 不予干涉法案
entries.en: Non-Interference Act

entries.zh: 前超光速文明应当享有不受外界干涉而自主发展的机会。
entries.en: Pre-FTL Civilizations should be given the chance to develop without outside interference.

entries.zh:

entries.en: §YInsight§! progress from observing pre-FTL Civilizations is increased by §G+25%§!.

entries.zh: 开发利用法案
entries.en: Exploitation Act

entries.zh: 前超光速文明受星系的掌控者管辖；每个帝国应当享有自由处置自身财产的权利。
entries.en: Pre-FTL worlds fall within the jurisdiction of whoever controls their system, and each empire should be allowed the freedom to treat their property in whichever way they see fit.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了§Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§!议案，禁止任何帝国继续施行§Y$interference_not_allowed$§!或§Y$interference_aggressive$§!政策。\n\n我们帝国当前的政策违反了这项议案。我们是否应该变更政策与大环境保持一致？
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the §Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§! resolution, forbidding empires from holding the §Y$interference_not_allowed$§! or §Y$interference_aggressive$§! policies.\n\nOur Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

entries.zh: 违反$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$
entries.en: Breach of $resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员们裁定，无论我们的用意为何，我们与§H[pre_ftl_country.GetName]§!的协议已经违反了§Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§!。\n\n$preftl.10050.outro$
entries.en: Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have determined that our treatment of the §H[pre_ftl_country.GetName]§! is in violation of the §Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§!, regardless of our intentions.\n\n$preftl.10050.outro$

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为§R违反星系法§!。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! for the next ten years. In addition, we have been issued with a hefty fine.

entries.en: Following our violation of the §Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§! due to our treatment of the §H[pre_ftl_country.GetName]§!, we have submitted the requisite paperwork to the officials of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium].
